# Palette reference

This file is generated from `src/theme.ts` and `src/colour/contrast.ts`. Regenerate it with `node scripts/gen-palette-reference.ts` after any change to a theme's colours; do not edit it by hand. Every contrast ratio below is computed by the same function `contrast-sufficient` calls at render time, against the exact fill each role resolves to.

The reasoning -- why colour is checked rather than merely chosen, and what the two new checks do and do not verify -- is [decision 0007](../decisions/0007-colour-is-checked-not-chosen.md).
